purposes.description: Store and maintain a durable learning record tied to your account.
purposes.withdrawalEffect: The learning record is required for account-backed progress. Withdrawing this consent will delete your account and learning data.

purposes.description: Use minimized, non-transcript events to improve the learning experience.

purposes.withdrawalEffect: Stops future reminders without deleting the learning record.
